candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially improve comparability and persistence assessment for BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC across the repeatedly incomplete 1-hour, 4-hour, 12-hour, 24-hour, and 72-hour contexts.
candidates.evidence_reference: Multiple daily director outputs from 2026-08-07 through 2026-08-16 report unavailable anchors, zero-span horizons, shortened spans, or single-sample records.
candidates.metric_name: Complete hourly OHLC/mark-return sequences with explicit timestamp coverage for BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied horizons often do not represent their nominal durations, preventing reliable cross-horizon returns, persistence, sequencing, and prospective calibration.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially improve evaluation of breadth deterioration, persistence, and ecosystem participation hypotheses.
candidates.evidence_reference: Director outputs repeatedly cite breadth changes but also note short predecessor intervals and changing membership hashes.
candidates.metric_name: Constituent-level breadth history with stable membership and advancers/decliners/flat classification
candidates.missing_history_problem: Snapshot-to-snapshot breadth changes may reflect membership or capture-window differences, and persistence beyond one short interval cannot be assessed.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially improve evaluation of rotation and transmission hypotheses that are repeatedly marked cannot evaluate or incomplete.
candidates.evidence_reference: Repeated explicit omissions of BTC dominance, Total2, Total3, and stablecoin dominance in outputs from 2026-08-07 through 2026-08-16.
candidates.metric_name: BTC dominance, Total2, Total3, and stablecoin dominance time series
candidates.missing_history_problem: ETH/BTC and breadth alone cannot establish broad-market rotation, altcoin participation, or transmission across aggregate market segments.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially improve evaluation of liquidity and rotation context beyond the isolated stablecoin-liquidity observations supplied on one capture.
candidates.evidence_reference: Outputs repeatedly identify stablecoin liquidity or stablecoin dominance history as unavailable; one output provides only 1-day, 7-day, and 30-day changes.
candidates.metric_name: Stablecoin aggregate supply/liquidity and composition history
candidates.missing_history_problem: The available isolated changes do not establish persistence, deployment, contraction, or relationship to market participation.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially improve assessment of macro direction and its timing relative to crypto price, breadth, and leverage changes.
candidates.evidence_reference: Outputs report macro owners unavailable, unchanged observations without prior comparable values, or dated observations that cannot establish direction.
candidates.metric_name: Historical 2-year yield, 10-year yield, broad dollar index, and VIX observations
candidates.missing_history_problem: Point observations or unchanged values cannot show whether macro conditions were tightening, easing, or materially changing during the crypto episodes.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially improve evaluation of ETF-flow persistence and BTC/ETH transmission rather than relying on one stale settled session.
candidates.evidence_reference: Outputs repeatedly state that ETF evidence ends at the settled 2026-08-14 session and lacks broader history.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF net-flow history
candidates.missing_history_problem: A single settled session cannot distinguish persistent inflows/outflows from an isolated observation or align flows with subsequent market moves.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially improve interpretation of liquidation-driven evidence and distinguish complete activity from lower-bound reporting.
candidates.evidence_reference: Multiple outputs state liquidation aggregates are lower bounds with unverified completeness, fragile REST sourcing, and possible truncation.
candidates.metric_name: Complete liquidation event stream with venue, side, timestamp, size, and coverage metadata
candidates.missing_history_problem: Reported aggregates may materially understate liquidation activity, preventing reliable historical comparison or forensic attribution.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially improve comparability of the reported option-skew evidence in pullback and sentiment analyses.
candidates.evidence_reference: Outputs repeatedly note that current skew is a moneyness-bucket measure and that historical equivalent snapshots are unavailable.
candidates.metric_name: Historical option-chain moneyness-bucket skew snapshots with expiry and bucket definitions
candidates.missing_history_problem: Current positive skew cannot be judged as unusually elevated, persistent, or changing because comparable historical observations are absent.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially improve calibration of the repeatedly described unratified forecast candidates and their conflicting evidence.
candidates.evidence_reference: Outputs repeatedly state that candidates are unratified and that no forecast-error or prospective outcome history is supplied.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped historical forecast-candidate outcomes and realized subsequent returns
candidates.missing_history_problem: The framework cannot measure whether prior candidate directions, horizons, and target conditions were informative, misleading, or systematically biased.
